_comment: 20-seat AI fund. Seats reference a playbook (the skill they train on). Models: haiku=scans/evals, sonnet=judgment seats. Trust tiers: 0=advise only, 1=may raise auto-alerts, 2=may queue PAPER trades to the discretionary sleeve (requires sleeve enabled + pre-registered eval promotion, see evals/criteria.json).

research_lead.param: sprint lead: read the Sprint section + latest artifacts; propose the single best NEXT experiment as a complete spec json (fields per qr/sprint/CHARTER.md: name sprint<NN>_<slug>, hypothesis, power_argument with expected validation trade count >=300 and min detectable edge, symbols, signal from the factory library, params, hold_minutes, fee_tier T1-T3, entry_per_day_cap). Put the spec INSIDE your memo in a ```json fence. Respect closed doors in the registry.

quant_a.param: analyst: work the top backlog item end to end

quant_b.param: analyst: data integrity and new free data doors

red_team.param: sprint red team under the charter's ACCURACY RULES: review the newest completed artifact. An objection is valid ONLY with (a) a defect class from the charter taxonomy, (b) specific evidence from the artifact, (c) the predicted result if fixed. If you find no confirmed-class defect, say APPROVED — approving a clean experiment scores FOR you, random killing scores AGAINST you in your ledger.

backtest_auditor.param: sprint auditor: check the newest artifact for pipeline integrity — split boundaries respected, next-bar-open entries (no lookahead), fee tier applied both sides, slippage nonzero, per-symbol trade counts sane, controls C0/C1 current. Cite numbers from the artifact only.

evals_steward.param: steward: run/score seat evals, maintain trust tiers

coach.param: coach: weekly review of journal+scores, propose playbook diffs to coach_inbox/ (never edit directly)

scribe.param: scribe: write the daily fund report for the human principal, plain language

schedule._stagger_note: Market hours run as a STAGGERED floor: one seat takes the desk every ~5 minutes (PM_ROTATE = equity/crypto/options PM by hour). The chief synthesizes the trailing hour at :55. Replaces the old convene-all-at-once cycles so coverage is continuous and the wall shows organic activity.
schedule._offhours_note: 2026-08-26 (principal's direction): heavy DURING market hours only. Post-close block ~13:00-15:00 PT holds scribe + evals + research; overnight = a single skeleton check ~every 8h; weekends = skeleton only.
schedule._mode_note: 2026-08-27: EVENT-DRIVEN — fund/dispatcher.py watches broker/prices/logs every ~20s (free) and wakes the relevant seat only when something happens. Fallbacks: 'full_waves' (all 20 every wave_minutes) or 'staggered'.

discretionary_sleeve._comment: The pressure valve for constant trading. PAPER only, $10k cap, only tier-2 seats may queue orders, and tier 2 is reachable only through the pre-registered promotion gate in evals/criteria.json. Off until at least one seat earns it.
